Every top college rugby program in America. Mapped.

Rugby Campus is a free guide to college rugby programs in the USA, across CRAA D1A and NCR D1. Each program is tiered on results, with coach contacts, conference, squad size, and MLR draft and playing numbers (drafted and played are counted separately), and campus details. Built by Hugh Johnston, an Australian who played, captained and then coached Notre Dame College to the 2023 NCR D1 National Championship.

Interactive map · All colleges · Guides · For coaches · About
